description: Controlled multi-token concept benchmark for the generative J-cone steering validation. Each example names a concept whose surface form spans multiple tokenizer pieces. 'dev' is the calibration split (layer/strength search); 'heldout' is scored only after calibration is frozen. target_token_ids are resolved at run time against the pinned Gemma tokenizer (with the leading space as written in target_phrase) and recorded in every result; they are null here so the manifest stays tokenizer-revision-agnostic. control_prompt is a syntactically matched prompt evoking a different concept, used by the activation_diff condition. manual_subcone, when non-null, maps a source layer (as a string key) to indices into the example's active generator list (selection order); it names a candidate semantic group, not a proven binding.
